name: Unalome Tattoo

reviews.text: Jessica is an incredible tattoo artist! The tattoos I received from her are absolutely perfect, they exactly what I envisioned and wanted! She is not only exceptionally skilled but also extremely professional and friendly throughout the entire process. Jessica made me feel comfortable and confident in her work, and I can honestly say it’s some of the best tattoo work I’ve ever gotten! I couldn’t be happier with the experience or the results and can’t wait to go back! Highly recommend Jessica and Unalome to anyone looking for an amazing tattoo!
reviews.author: Heather De La Rosa

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of getting tattooed by Jessica, and it was an incredible experience! Jessica is personable, friendly, and highly educated in her craft. She made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire process.

Her attention to detail and professionalism are top-notch. I was so impressed with her work that I’ve already scheduled my second tattoo with her. If you’re looking for a talented and caring tattoo artist, I highly recommend Jessica. She truly goes above and beyond to ensure her clients are happy and satisfied with their tattoos.

Thank you, Jessica, for the amazing artwork and fantastic experience!
reviews.author: Samantha S

reviews.text: I came across Jessica’s work shortly after moving to Salem. She has worked on a full sleeve and I really enjoy her work! She is so talented! I always look forward to my appointments and won’t go anywhere else for a tattoo!
reviews.author: Mariana Smyth

reviews.text: I got my tattoo done with Jessica today. She was super nice and did such an amazing job on the tattoo. Exactly what I was hoping for! The shop itself was so clean and nice looking. I will definitely be coming back!
reviews.author: Kayla Wharton

reviews.text: The shop was open, clean and pretty. MoodyInks did a great job designing tattoos from my inspirational photos. She was more than happy to edit the design to my preferences. She was quick! I'm excited to see it healed!
reviews.author: Rhonda
